comment: Deleted #4 CONTRACT_ARTICLE on Art. 2 Abs. 2 der Postverordnung (VPG; SR 783.01): a Verordnung with an SR number is an act given by title, so BARE_ARTICLE Art. 2 Abs. 2. Kept #5 BARE_ARTICLE as one chain span Art. 1 und Art. 32 (des Postgesetzes); guideline does not say whether a BARE_ARTICLE chain is one or two spans. Kept #34 BARE_ARTICLE Artikel 43 followed by bracketed [VPG]; bracketed abbreviation treated as outside the span.
